hook.name: FarmHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as a yield farm and liquidity manager, enforcing full-range liquidity added only through the hook. Charges a 1% swap fee routed to a fee recipient, distributes minted reward tokens via a Synthetix-style accumulator with tiered emissions (6.6M/day bootstrap, then 660k/day), and applies a 10% claim tax redistributed to current LPs.
